Since $\overset{―}{kv}=\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v},$ we get the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{kv} & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v} \\ [\begin{aligned}-5-10\text{i} \\ 10\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 2+4\text{i}\end{aligned}]} \\ [\begin{aligned}-5-10\text{i} \\ 10\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{-5} \\ \overset{―}{2+4\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}-5-10\text{i} \\ 10\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 2-4\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}-5-10\text{i} \\ 10\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-5\overset{―}{k} \\ (2-4\text{i})\overset{―}{k}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we obtain the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}-5\overset{―}{k}=-5-10\text{i} \\ (2-4\text{i})\overset{―}{k}=10.\end{aligned}
$$

From the first equation, we get 

$$
\overset{―}{k}=1+2\text{i}.
$$

Substituting this into the second equation, we obtain the true statement

$$
(2-4\text{i})(1+2\text{i})=10.
$$

Therefore, $k=\overset{―}{1+2\text{i}}=1-2\text{i}.$

Finally, $\text{Re}(k)=1.$
